title: Manufacturing Supply Chain Accounting
description: Guide to supply chain accounting including vendor management, purchase orders, receiving, inventory management, and supplier performance.

sections.title: Supply Chain Accounting
sections.content: TO BE COMPLETED - Procurement process, purchase orders, receiving and inspection, vendor management, payment terms, early payment discounts, consignment inventory, drop-shipping, JIT inventory, EOQ (Economic Order Quantity), safety stock, lead time. Need 8,000 words.
